topics.title: Nerandomilast (1305-0023) FIBRONEER-ILD PPF – China NDA Approval & CN PI Summary

background.text: FIBRONEER-ILD Ph3 (1305-0023) PPF: China NDA approved Dec 9, 2025 – first country globally to obtain NDA approval for PPF indication. US NDA approved Jan 2026.
background.quote: CN status: The NDA was approved on Dec 9th, making China the first country globally to obtain NDA approval for the PPF indication!

background.text: CN PPF PI: indicated for PPF in adults; recommended dose 18 mg twice daily; dose reduction to 9 mg BID allowed except when used concomitantly with pirfenidone; adverse reactions similar to IPF section; efficacy data includes primary endpoint, subgroup analyses (AF/non-AF, HRCT patterns, ILD diagnosis), key secondary endpoint and mortality data.
background.quote:
Indications：This product is indicated for the treatment of Progressive Pulmonary Fibrosis (PPF) in adult patients.
Dosage: The recommended dosage of this product is 18 mg twice daily
